modelingNotes: Exact order 1207700000, HDC HE 16 FS female screw-terminated insert, installation size 6. The exact manufacturer customer drawing visibly marks rows 1-8 and 9-16; BOM item 4 CONTACTOR is silver-plated brass, item 3 PE CONTACT is nickel-plated brass. No numbering or ratings are transferred from an FP variant or the adjacent 17-32 insert. No phase, polarity or application net is assigned.

C.1-C.16 and M.1-M.16 are authoring aliases separating each fixed numbered contact conductor into cable screw termination and female mating endpoint. C/M are not printed manufacturer side markings; terminalOrder is logical and does not prescribe a physical viewing direction or installed orientation.

Represent the 16 fixed contact conductors by explicit project jumpers C.n-M.n for n=1 through 16, supported by the exact drawing and screw-termination/female-contactor construction. These represent factory conductors, not field-installed jumpers. No numbered contact joins another numbered contact or PE. Singleton bus functions and connector metadata do not join nets.

PE represents the verified conductive PE assembly as one aggregate node. The exact sheet specifies a PE screw connection and the drawing identifies the PE contact assembly. Individual cable/mating/end-hardware interfaces remain unenumerated: connectionCoverage is partial. No invented C.PE/M.PE, left/right PE identifiers, split-PE fixed link, or automatic hood/mating-half bond is asserted.

The aggregate PE endpoint is required by explicit library policy for this connector model's protective-earth use; this is not a manufacturer instruction for every possible application. Ordinary numbered contacts remain application-dependent. Projects may annotate deliberate non-use. External protective bonding must be established by the project; PE presence does not prove an upstream bond.

Exact datasheet https://datasheet.weidmueller.com/pdf/en/1207700000/scope/2/, creation 18.02.2026 11:02:29 MEZ, pp.1-4: DIN EN 61984 rating 500 V / 16 A, impulse 6 kV, pollution severity 3, insulation group IIIa. UL/CSA voltage is 600 V AC/DC. UR current at AWG12/14/16/18/20 is 20/15/10/7/5 A; cUR is 19.7/15/11.3/10.3/8 A. Ratings are approval/wire-dependent capabilities; no assigned nominal_voltage or unconditional scalar current is modeled.

Exact sheet pp.2-4: limiting temperature -40 to +125 degC is not a full-current-at-every-ambient claim. Main terminal: 0.5-2.5 mm2 solid or finely stranded, ferruled maximum 2.5 mm2, AWG20-14, M3, 9 mm strip. AWG12 in the approval table does not authorize exceeding the stated terminal range. PE: M4, rated 4 mm2, AWG20-12, 10 mm strip, 1.2-1.5 Nm. Numbered contacts are copper alloy, silver passivated; no extra dedicated signal contact is present (16 power, zero signal contacts).

Main-contact torque revision discrepancy: exact 2026 sheet specifies 0.6-0.7 Nm; linked manufacturer HDC tightening table https://assets.dam.weidmueller.com/assets/api/719442ee-190c-4c27-8b06-0fb4d3eaf6d9/original/HDC_Tightening_torques.pdf, 1460950000 / 2014/2015, p.A.17, specifies HE M3 0.5-0.55 Nm. Both specify HE M4 PE 1.2-1.5 Nm. Confirm the installed hardware/manufacturer instruction before tightening; no universal main-contact torque is selected.

No additional shield, auxiliary or communication terminal is established for this exact insert. Hood/enclosure, mating insert and coding accessories are separate components. Installed revision, mating compatibility, assembly bonding and circuit suitability remain project checks.

connectionCoverage.notes: Exact numbered contacts 1-16 have cable and female mating aliases (32 endpoints) and 16 fixed paths. Verified PE assembly is one aggregate PE endpoint; individual PE cable/mating/bond interfaces are not separately enumerated or linked. No hood or mating-half bond is assumed.
